title: Preserve MIDI bank selection and bank changes
scope: Retain GP5 bank values and GPIF MSB/LSB sound definitions and ordered bank-change events.
acceptance: Preserve banks 0, 77 and 256 from upstream GP5/GP8 bank fixtures.
In bank-change.gp, retain the bank 256 event at its exact bar/position together with its program event.
Check bank ranges before conversion and keep duplicate-position event order through public editing and independent export.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: An authored bank 256 automation disappears in GP8 export.
